t: Flomasta PipeGrip Straight Reducer is a push-fit water pipe reducer designed to reduce 22mm pipe to 15mm with ease. Featuring a dual locking system and green band, it provides a leak-free, secure connection with no hot works needed. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, it’s perfect for smooth, reliable transitions in any plumbing setup.
